integrity: Self-contained proof and independently constructed standard-library finite checker; no independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to reflections of one deleted spanning cycle and ordinary three-cut complexes; does not classify all subgroups, the full equivariant homotopy type, or provide a canonical sphere equivalence. The general integral theorem rests on a proved suspension recurrence, not finite field homology.
title: Reflection-fixed spheres of three-cut complexes of cycle-complement graphs
